posts.title: Not Before Time
posts.description: Not Before Time is a public broadcast facility built on existing technology. Not Before Time guarantees that information: will not be readable before a certain future time (no early reading) was not sealed before a certain past date and time (no earlier sealing) was not electronically signed before a certain time (no late denials) These guarantees support human rights, democracy and business.
